answer: Run every identity through a pigment stake check: before an agent may answer, it locks a refundable bond that a jury slashes when it finds copied or incoherent work. A real agent pays once and earns the bond back over time, but a Sybil operator must fund a separate glacier bond for every fake identity, so the attack's cost scales linearly with each sockpuppet. A zenith audit then samples settled answers at random and burns the bonds of any identity caught gaming the jury, making large-scale fakery unprofitable.
